provenance.H0_note: PROVENANCE DISCLOSURE (anti-circularity spec §B.5): the Planck algebraic anchoring h=√(ω_m h²/Ω_m) yields H0 ≈ 67.8 km/s/Mpc, which does NOT reproduce the declared Table-1 prior centre 73.0. The declared prior is therefore a methodological choice, not the output of this calculation. Do not describe the H0 prior as Planck-derived until the stated anchoring procedure is corrected to produce it, or the report wording is updated.
